atoms.text: Rebecca is a 24-year-old lawyer who lives in London. She loves her job, but sometimes she finds living in London a little overwhelming. She decided to go camping in West Wales for the weekend with some friends to get out of the city. Unfortunately, on the way to the campsite the car broke down. The group of friends had to push the car for 15 minutes.
